purpose: 只沿真实导航链接读取发布目录与原分页代码，执行前保存完整程序
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import requests,json,hashlib,re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd()
R='reports/research/510300_industrial_multidimensional_cash_constraint_source_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
nav=json.loads((OUT/'原数据导航实际读取.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
real=[x for x in nav['all_actual_links'] if x['text']=='数据发布' and '/sj/zxfb/' in x['absolute_url']]
assert len(real)==1
url=real[0]['absolute_url']
reg=OUT/'原数据发布目录GET前登记.json';assert not reg.exists()
reg.write_text(json.dumps({'at':now(),'url':url,'source':R+'/原数据导航实际读取.json','GET_target_number':7,'retries':0,'no_current_view':True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
response=requests.get(url,timeout=30,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
b=response.content
p=OUT/'sources/catalog_latest_release.html';assert not p.exists();p.write_bytes(b)
soup=BeautifulSoup(b.decode('utf-8',errors='replace'),'html.parser')
links=[{'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'href_original':a.get('href'),'absolute_url':urljoin(response.url,a.get('href'))} for a in soup.find_all('a',href=True)]
scripts=[{'src':x.get('src'),'absolute_url':urljoin(response.url,x.get('src'))} for x in soup.find_all('script',src=True)]
pagination=[x.get_text() for x in soup.find_all('script') if any(s in x.get_text() for s in ['createPage','totalPage','pageNum','pageCount','json','XML','xml'])]
result={'at':now(),'requested_url':url,'final_url':response.url,'status_code':response.status_code,
'path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(b),
'all_actual_links':links,'all_actual_script_urls':scripts,'original_embedded_pagination_scripts':pagination,
'new_GETs':1,'cumulative_new_original_GETs':7,'retries':0,'new_models':0}
p=OUT/'原数据发布目录实际读取.json';assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'实际目录HTTP':response.status_code,'实际分页链接':[x for x in links if re.search(r'index_|下一页|末页|下页|尾页',x['text']+x['absolute_url'])][:18],
'实际分页脚本':pagination[:5],'候选源脚本':[x for x in scripts if re.search('page|public|common|publish',x['src'])]},ensure_ascii=False))
